scope: remaining loss classes: revision/compat metadata, comments, revisions, textboxes, OLE, document metadata
implemented: revision save identifiers and the Word 6/7 + Asian layout controls whose bare value is the Strict default are named Info instead of Loss: `\insrsid`/`\charrsid`/`\pararsid` (non-visual merge metadata; the model carries optional `w:rsid*` slots the renderer never reads), `\faauto`/`\adjustright`/`\aspalpha`/`\aspnum` (whose bare form is the WML default `w:textAlignment=auto`, `w:adjustRightInd` on, `w:autoSpaceDE`/`w:autoSpaceDN` on, so a mapping would write nothing back), and `\hyphpar`/`\wrapdefault`/`\sectdefaultcl`/`\linex`/`\lnbrkrule`/`\partightenfactor`. A non-default form (`\hyphpar0`, `\adjustright0`, ...) has no slot in the paragraph model and stays an explicit Loss. Corpus import losses 83010 -> 11394.
remaining: comments, tracked revisions, textboxes/shapes, OLE objects and document metadata (author/dates/docprops) are still Loss; they need per-class mapping tasks (RC08 already took fields/bookmarks/notes).
the WPS-only `wps:leading-group-line-ending` marker (2541) is still Loss; it is a WPS source artifact with no Strict slot.
table cell props still Loss: `\trpadd{t,b,l,r}`/`\trpaddf{t,b,l,r}` (table default cell padding -> `w:tblCellMar`), `\trrh`, `\trqr`/`\trftsWidth`, `\trautofit`; and cell text direction `\cltxlrtb`.
character controls still Loss: `\ulc` (underline colour -> `w:u/@w:color`), `\kerning` (old `\kern`), `\cb`, `\pardeftab` (default tab stop), `\nooverflow`/`\nocwrap` (cell wrap), `\animtext`.

assertions: the bare legacy controls and revision ids produce loss_count 0 and a named `*-compat:` Info (`rsid-compat`, `word6-compat`, `paragraph-compat`)
`\hyphpar0` and `\adjustright0` stay `control:*` Loss (negative control; the paragraph model has no suppressAutoHyphens/adjustRightInd slot)
